user_intent: 如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF aqara_smoke_sensor.reading() > 0.93 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN power_on() viomi_hood
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN power_off() viomi_hood
